title: Exhaustion for Covering-Group Supercuspidal Data
body_html:
Exhaustion for Covering-Group Supercuspidal Data

The covering datum \(\widetilde\Sigma\) gives an irreducible genuine supercuspidal representation \(\widetilde\pi_{\widetilde\Sigma}\). Two such representations are isomorphic exactly when the covering data are equivalent. For the metaplectic cover in the relevant type I dual pairs, every genuine supercuspidal representation is obtained from such a datum under the paper's large-\(p\) hypotheses.
proof_html: This is the aggregate of Theorem 3.14, Theorem 3.17, and Corollary 3.18. Irreducibility follows by comparing covering-group intertwiners with Yu's ordinary intertwining calculation. Equivalence reduces to Hakim-Murnaghan weak symmetry and then to the depth-zero covering theory after aligning semisimple elements. The metaplectic exhaustion uses conservation relations to move to an odd orthogonal partner where ordinary Kim exhaustion applies, then returns through Proposition 9.1.
